name: czl-ashare-research-writer
description: A股投研内容生产线：把一只股票、一个板块或一份持仓，变成可交付、可复核、可发布的研究内容。内置零依赖取数、A股规则校验、六维诊断、双法定价、七段成稿与十项交付闸门。

displayDescription.zh: 面向沪深京A股，把公开信息做成能交出去的研究内容：六维诊断、双法定价、大盘复盘、持仓体检，产出可打印的HTML与Markdown，数据标来源、结论附证伪条件。不做买卖指令。
displayDescription.en: Turns public A-share information into deliverable research: six-dimension diagnosis, two-method valuation with implied-expectation reverse engineering, market and sector reviews, portfolio exposure audits, and a thesis ledger — delivered as printable HTML plus matching Markdown, gated by ten pre-delivery checks.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我诊断一下贵州茅台（600519），我要知道它现在值不值得继续看下去
defaultInitPrompt.en: Diagnose Kweichow Moutai (600519) — is it worth my time right now?

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我诊断一下贵州茅台（600519），我要知道它现在值不值得继续看下去
quickPrompts.en: Diagnose Kweichow Moutai (600519) — is it worth my time right now?

quickPrompts.zh: 这只票现在贵不贵？给我一个区间，并告诉我当前价格隐含了什么增长假设
quickPrompts.en: Is this stock expensive? Give me a range and what growth the current price already implies

quickPrompts.zh: 把刚才的分析整理成一篇能发出去的稿子，HTML 和 Markdown 都要
quickPrompts.en: Turn that analysis into a publishable article — both HTML and Markdown

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做今天的大盘复盘，给出情绪温度和明日三个可验证的观察点
quickPrompts.en: Review today's market with a sentiment reading and three verifiable watch items

quickPrompts.zh: 我手里的这几只票，风险是不是堆在一处了？帮我做敞口体检
quickPrompts.en: Are my holdings' risks concentrated? Run an exposure audit
